note: Pre-rendered 3D assets. Rendered offline with tools/render-assets (three.js, physically based materials with real transmission for glass, HDRI lighting); glass is shot on black and on white and matte.py recovers true transparency. The school pictures, verse-garden and obj-moon are images the project owner made with an image AI (cartoon 3D style, 2026), cut out of their plain background with BiRefNet.
